successCriteria.description: src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts exists and exports LeavePolicy interface with all specified fields: id, policyName, leaveType (LeaveType), entitlementDays, accrualRate?, maxAccumulation?, minimumNoticeDays?, requiresManagerApproval, isActive, createdAt, updatedAt
src/modules/policy/policy.model.ts exports CreateLeavePolicyDto and UpdateLeavePolicyDto types (omitting id/createdAt/updatedAt; UpdateLeavePolicyDto has all fields optional)
src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts exports IPolicyRepository interface declaring findByLeaveType, findById, findAll, create, update, and soft-delete method signatures
src/modules/policy/policy.repository.ts exports PolicyRepository class implementing IPolicyRepository, using the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts for all database operations
PolicyRepository.soft-delete sets isActive=false (does not physically delete the row)
Jest unit tests exist in tests/unit/modules/policy/ covering the model types and repository methods (mocking the pg pool)
LeaveType is imported from src/shared/types/index.ts — not redefined locally

constraints: All database access must go through the repository layer (GP-001) — PolicyRepository uses the pg Pool from src/shared/db/connection.ts
No `any` type — use `unknown` with type guards where needed (HARNESS.json constraint no-any)
Strict TypeScript: no implicit any, strict null checks
LeaveType must be imported from src/shared/types/index.ts (Phase 1 dependency), not redefined
Tests must mock the pg Pool — no real database connections in unit tests
outOfScope: Policy service, controller, and routes — deferred to Phase 7
Database migrations for leave_policies table — deferred to Phase 9
Audit logging (GP-002) — repository methods in this phase do not write audit records; that responsibility belongs to the service layer in Phase 7
RBAC enforcement (GP-005) — deferred to controller/route layer in Phase 7
Input validation beyond TypeScript type safety — deferred to service layer in Phase 7
Employee module dependency — policy module in this phase has no dependency on employee; that relationship is wired in later phases

ambiguities.description: The `id` field type on LeavePolicy is not explicitly stated in the intent. The architecture doc and Phase 9 migrations use UUID (string). The code-agent should infer `string` (UUID).
